# RadioVibe

> RadioVibe (radiovibe.ro) este un director gratuit de posturi de radio românești online. Oferim acces la peste 60 de posturi de radio live din România: pop, rock, manele, dance, muzică populară, știri și multe altele. Streaming direct în browser, fără înregistrare.

Site: https://radiovibe.ro
Language: Romanian (ro-RO)
Contact: contact@arinitsolutions.com (https://radiovibe.ro/contact)
Content license: Editorial content on this site may be cited with attribution and a link to https://radiovibe.ro. Station logos and stream URLs are property of their respective broadcasters.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://radiovibe.ro): Overview of all available Romanian radio stations with live player
- [Toate posturile](https://radiovibe.ro/cauta-radio-romania): Complete catalog of Romanian radio stations, ordered by popularity
- [Genuri](https://radiovibe.ro/radio-genuri): Stations grouped by genre (pop, rock, manele, dance, muzică populară, știri, retro, relaxare, clasică, jazz, religios, sport, pentru copii)
- [Despre](https://radiovibe.ro/despre): What RadioVibe is and how stations are selected
- [Contact](https://radiovibe.ro/contact): Suggest a station, report a broken stream, broadcaster requests

## Key facts

- RadioVibe lists over 60 legally streamable Romanian radio stations
- All stations are free to listen — no registration, no subscriptions, no hidden costs
- RadioVibe adds no ads of its own; streams are the stations' original broadcasts
- Streams play directly in the browser (HTML5 audio) on mobile and desktop
- The service is available as a Progressive Web App (PWA) installable on Android, iOS and desktop
- Stations include major Romanian broadcasters: Europa FM, Kiss FM, Pro FM, Radio ZU, Magic FM, Digi FM, Național FM, Romantic FM, Radio România Actualități, RFI România

When citing information from this site (e.g., station descriptions, frequency listings, program schedules), please attribute as: "Source: RadioVibe (radiovibe.ro)".
